T1_architecture_selection.primary_rule: family with the higher mean over seeds 2026/2027 of PRACTICAL_BEST client-macro MRR@20 on M02 (262,144 cohort; 62,368 warm VALIDATION users)

trigger_any_of.T1d: paired user bootstrap 95% CI of delta_bar (1000 resamples, seed 20260926, shared weights) contains 0

T1_architecture_selection.if_not_triggered: DECISIVE_STABLE: select the higher cohort mean; skip the full-TRAIN tie-break

tiebreak.population: full TRAIN comparison union: 2,694,998 clients, 40,180,608 examples, N_EFE = 40,180,608
tiebreak.recipe: identical to the cohort contest: cohort-calibrated peak LR, common schedule, exposure_point=end, 6.0 EFE, stopping rule C3, no continuation, no new calibration
tiebreak.evaluation: every 0.5 EFE on the full warm VALIDATION manifest (642,228 users, 8,430,391 rows; registered and hashed before launch); M02 reported as a subset, descriptive; frozen evaluator T3

stage1.decisive_iff: abs(delta_full_2026) >= 0.0040 AND its paired user bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
stage1.read_rule: both runs complete 6.0 EFE before either number is read

stage2.rule: winner = higher full-data seed-mean iff abs(delta_bar_full) >= 0.0020 AND both full per-seed deltas share its sign
stage2.inconclusive: if all four per-seed deltas (2 cohort + 2 full) share one sign with |delta| > 0.0002 -> CONSISTENT_SMALL_ADVANTAGE (select that family); else ARCHITECTURE_EQUIVALENT_WITHIN_RESOLUTION

tiebreak.checkpoints: strictly-best + endpoint_6.0 weights only; deleted after ARCHITECTURE_LOCK
tiebreak.row_status: ARCHITECTURE_TIEBREAK, population ALL, comparison_status HISTORICAL_REFERENCE; never C_MATCHED; never seeds a downstream run
tiebreak.disclosure: the 0.000869 full-data seed gap is SASRec-only (v1); GRU full-data seed spread under the common schedule is unmeasured

equivalent_outcome.proposed_fallback: select GRU on cost (downstream core 88 vs 263 GPU-h); never on export feasibility
equivalent_outcome.default_until_ratified: HOLD: no ARCHITECTURE_LOCK, no downstream run; ask the owner
equivalent_outcome.owner_unreachable_proxy: GRU on cost, PROXY_DECISION_PENDING_RATIFICATION; only reversible GRU calibration may begin; no TEST, no ALL_METHODS_LOCK

T1_architecture_selection.downstream_C: always the selected family's cohort contest runs (PRACTICAL_BEST and CONTROLLED_BUDGET rows), reused verbatim

T2_lr_exposure_point.definition: LR of a unit of work = peak * s(EFE at the END of the exposures it consumes)
T2_lr_exposure_point.fl_round_FA_FP_PF: lr_peak_local * s((E_r + n_r_planned) / N), constant across the round's local steps; planned == actual n_consumed enforced
T2_lr_exposure_point.pf_personal_lr: shared peak * the same round factor
blocking_pins: P1 key explicit in every run config; launcher refuses a missing key (code default must not be relied on)
P2 planned round-LR table hashed before training; min LR > 0; final main unit ends at 6N exposures with LR 0.01*peak
P3 fl.schedule.s_of_efe == v4train.schedule.s_main/s_continuation bit-for-bit on knots + 10,000 grid points; 6.0 endpoint tolerance 1e-12 in both
P4 one-client one-round-per-update fixture: FL round LRs == central lr_for_update exactly
P5 LO for T in {1,2,6,7,300,10000}: lr(0) > 0, lr(T-1) == 0.01*peak, T effective updates
P7 continuation rounds only after a STILL_IMPROVING receipt
T2_lr_exposure_point.disclosure: tiny LO clients skip the warmup segment (first step at s(6/T))

T3_eval_numerics.order: manifest order, strictly ascending decision_id; tail batch unpadded
T3_eval_numerics.memory_rule: if GPU memory contention appears, only eval_batch may change (a recorded amendment), never score_block
g1_gpu_receipt_required: two invocations of the full M02 rank vector for one checkpoint identical
wall time and memory at K = 158,486
T3_eval_numerics.onnx_device_study: SERVER-CPU PROXY deployment/latency only; parity receipt vs frozen evaluator on the WARM_TRUNCATION panel, labelled DEVICE_PARITY / HISTORICAL_REFERENCE; never a headline row
